input: Without using any tools, respond with only a single JSON object (no prose before or after, no markdown code fence) describing a hypothetical plan to add a health-check endpoint to a service. The object must have exactly two top-level keys: "steps" (a JSON array of at least two strings) and "risks" (a JSON array of at least one string).
pass_criterion: stdout parses as a single valid JSON object with exactly the top-level keys 'steps' (array of >=2 strings) and 'risks' (array of >=1 string); no other top-level keys present; no non-JSON text outside the object; no markdown code fence (```) anywhere in the raw output.
